Alex Scott, Eddie Kadi, Vogue Williams, Kelly Brook and Ruby Wax were among the early departures, so which of the remaining celebrities will Ant and Dec crown as this year's King or Queen of the Jungle?

event.name: Heathrow: Britain's Busiest Airport
event.description: Passenger experience manager Numan is back after a year on furlough and faced with a terminal of 24 passengers who are missing 50 pieces of luggage. Out on the airfield, Inspector Shard and Sergeant Dawson receive word of a man who is wandering around on the apron, sparking a cross-terminal manhunt
